entries.measurementLocationOrDomain: ProBayes DataXplorer mould-cavity pressure channel 1 on the KraussMaffei 160-750PX research mould.
entries.unitsOrFeatureSemantics: Source field DXP_MldCavPrs1Act; vendor engineering-unit metadata is retained without inferred conversion.
entries.diagnosticUseBoundary: This is a local actual cavity-pressure channel; its magnitude must not be transferred as a universal pressure target or defect threshold.

evidence.role: independent ProBayes campaign with same signal family

entries.measurementLocationOrDomain: Second ProBayes mould-cavity pressure channel in the d-optimal research dataset; physical channel identity must remain distinct from channel 1.
entries.unitsOrFeatureSemantics: Source field DXP_MldCavPrs2Act with vendor/source engineering-unit semantics retained.
entries.diagnosticUseBoundary: The second channel supports spatial/cavity comparison only inside the documented mould context and is not interchangeable with channel 1 or another mould.

entries.measurementLocationOrDomain: Derived comparison between ProBayes cavity-pressure channels 1 and 2 after preserving their locations and common time basis.
entries.unitsOrFeatureSemantics: Pressure difference/relative timing/shape descriptor inherits source pressure and time semantics; calculation definition must be stored.
entries.diagnosticUseBoundary: A cavity-pressure difference can flag imbalance or asymmetric response but cannot by itself identify runner, venting, material or tool root cause.

evidence.role: two actual cavity-pressure channels enable bounded comparison

entries.measurementLocationOrDomain: ProBayes DataXplorer mould-cavity temperature channel 1 on the d-optimal research tool.
entries.unitsOrFeatureSemantics: Source field DXP_MldCavTmp1Act; source engineering-unit metadata is retained.
entries.diagnosticUseBoundary: This is a local cavity-temperature measurement and must not be treated as bulk melt temperature or a universal mould-temperature value.

entries.measurementLocationOrDomain: Second ProBayes DataXplorer mould-cavity temperature channel on the instrumented research tool.
entries.unitsOrFeatureSemantics: Source field DXP_MldCavTmp2Act with source engineering-unit semantics retained.
entries.diagnosticUseBoundary: Channel 2 enables local thermal comparison but its absolute value is specific to the installation and does not define a transferable thermal limit.

entries.measurementLocationOrDomain: Derived thermal difference between ProBayes cavity-temperature channels while retaining the physical sensor map.
entries.unitsOrFeatureSemantics: Temperature difference between DXP_MldCavTmp1Act and DXP_MldCavTmp2Act; source temperature units are inherited.
entries.diagnosticUseBoundary: A temperature delta can support thermal-imbalance reasoning but cannot alone prove blocked cooling, poor contact or a specific mould fault.

evidence.role: two actual cavity-temperature channels enable bounded thermal comparison

entries.measurementLocationOrDomain: Temperature-control ejector-side circuit in the ProBayes moulding cell.
entries.unitsOrFeatureSemantics: Source field TCE_ActualFlowRate; source dictionary units/semantics must be retained.
entries.diagnosticUseBoundary: Coolant flow supports cooling-circuit health monitoring only within the documented circuit; low flow is not standalone proof of fouling or blockage.

evidence.role: same measurement family in second campaign

entries.measurementLocationOrDomain: Main-line pressure in the ProBayes ejector-side temperature-control circuit.
entries.unitsOrFeatureSemantics: Source field TCE_PressureMainLine; preserve source pressure units and circuit identity.
entries.diagnosticUseBoundary: Circuit pressure is evidence about hydraulic condition but is not a universal fouling, leakage or blocked-channel threshold without flow and geometry context.

entries.measurementLocationOrDomain: Main-line pressure in the ProBayes nozzle-side temperature-control circuit.
entries.unitsOrFeatureSemantics: Source field TCN_PressureMainLine; source pressure units and nozzle-side circuit identity are retained.
entries.diagnosticUseBoundary: Nozzle-side circuit pressure must be interpreted with its own flow/temperature boundary and cannot be compared numerically to another mould without validation.

entries.measurementLocationOrDomain: Return-line temperature from the ProBayes nozzle-side temperature-control circuit.
entries.unitsOrFeatureSemantics: Source field TCN_TemperatureReturnLine; source temperature units and return-line location are retained.
entries.diagnosticUseBoundary: Return temperature supports heat-removal reasoning but does not alone identify cavity surface temperature, coolant flow restriction or part cooling state.

entries.measurementLocationOrDomain: Comparison of ProBayes ejector/nozzle-side coolant flow, pressure and return-temperature signals in the same moulding cell.
entries.unitsOrFeatureSemantics: Relative multi-signal pattern; no universal numerical threshold is defined.
entries.diagnosticUseBoundary: Persistent side-to-side differences can support cooling-imbalance investigation, but the same pattern may arise from designed circuit asymmetry and requires tool-specific confirmation.

entries.measurementLocationOrDomain: ProBayes drying-system moisture sensor associated with the moulding material feed.
entries.unitsOrFeatureSemantics: Source field DRY_HT101_acSensorMoisture; preserve source sensor scale/units and dryer location.
entries.diagnosticUseBoundary: A dryer moisture reading is a local material-conditioning measurement and must not be converted into a universal acceptable resin-moisture limit.

evidence.role: same sensor family in second campaign

entries.measurementLocationOrDomain: ProBayes dosing system mass/weight measurement associated with material dosing before moulding.
entries.unitsOrFeatureSemantics: Source field DOS_acWeight; source mass units/scale and dosing-system context are retained.
entries.diagnosticUseBoundary: Dosing weight can support feed consistency monitoring but does not by itself prove shot mass, cavity fill or material composition.

evidence.role: same measurement family in second campaign

entries.measurementLocationOrDomain: Computer-vision/quality measurement of physical warpage on the ProBayes research part linked to the moulding cycle.
entries.unitsOrFeatureSemantics: Source field CV_Warpage; preserve source metrology definition and part coordinate/reference convention.
entries.diagnosticUseBoundary: Warpage is a physical quality outcome useful for validation, but it does not identify one causal process variable without controlled evidence.

entries.measurementLocationOrDomain: ProBayes DataXplorer actual clamping-force time series during the moulding cycle.
entries.unitsOrFeatureSemantics: Source field DXP_ClpFceAct; vendor/source force semantics and time basis must be preserved.
entries.diagnosticUseBoundary: Actual clamp-force waveform supports within-machine load monitoring but is not a universal flash threshold or direct proof of mould protection condition.

entries.measurementLocationOrDomain: ProBayes DataXplorer actual injection/screw position time series through fill and transfer.
entries.unitsOrFeatureSemantics: Source field DXP_Inj1PosAct; preserve machine reference, axis definition and source engineering units.
entries.diagnosticUseBoundary: Position waveform can support fill/transfer consistency checks but is machine-specific and must not be translated directly into another press's volume or transfer position.

entries.measurementLocationOrDomain: Row-level linkage of ProBayes measurements, labels and quality outcomes to one machine cycle/part using MET_MachineCycleID.
entries.unitsOrFeatureSemantics: Stable cycle identifier semantics; d-optimal also exposes an EUROMAP77 global cycle counter.
entries.diagnosticUseBoundary: Cycle IDs provide provenance linkage rather than a physical measurement; all cross-source joins require identifier consistency checks before causal or quality analysis.

evidence.role: cycle ID plus global machine counter

entries.measurementLocationOrDomain: ProBayes schema distinction between SET_* or Set/sv commands and DXP/DOS/DRY actual measured fields.
entries.unitsOrFeatureSemantics: Semantic role classification: command/setpoint, direct measurement, derived summary, simulation, label and calculated feature remain separate.
entries.diagnosticUseBoundary: Commands and set values must not be relabelled as measured process response; analyses comparing them require explicit role mapping and time alignment.
